modules.title: Career Development Basics
modules.description: Learn the fundamentals of a career development path for design.

sub_modules.title: Defining Your Career Goals
sub_modules.description: Identify your strengths, weaknesses, and interests to create a personalized career plan.
learning_outcomes: Define your career goals.
Identify your strengths, weaknesses, and interests.

sub_modules.title: Career Development Frameworks
sub_modules.description: Learn about common career development frameworks for design professionals.

activities.name: Analyzing a Design Professional's Career Path

learning_outcomes: Understand common career development frameworks for design professionals.
Apply these frameworks to your own career path.

modules.title: Design-Specific Skills Development
modules.description: Build essential skills for a successful career in design.

sub_modules.title: Visual Design Principles
sub_modules.description: Master visual design principles to create effective and visually appealing designs.
learning_outcomes: Understand visual design principles and how to apply them in practice.
Develop effective design skills for professional projects.

sub_modules.title: User Experience (UX) Fundamentals
sub_modules.description: Learn the basics of UX design to create user-centered designs.

activities.name: Analyzing a Design's Effectiveness for Users

learning_outcomes: Understand the basics of UX design and how to apply them in practice.
Develop skills for creating user-centered designs.

modules.title: Soft Skills Development
modules.description: Cultivate essential soft skills for a successful career in design.

sub_modules.title: Communication and Collaboration
sub_modules.description: Develop strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with teams and clients.
learning_outcomes: Understand the importance of communication and collaboration in design teams.
Develop skills for effective communication and collaboration.

sub_modules.title: Time Management and Productivity
sub_modules.description: Learn strategies for efficient time management and productivity to meet deadlines and deliver quality work.

activities.name: Tracking Your Productivity and Time Management

learning_outcomes: Understand the importance of time management and productivity in design work.
Develop strategies for efficient time management and productivity.

modules.title: Career Advancement Strategies
modules.description: Learn how to advance your career as a professional designer.

sub_modules.title: Networking and Building Relationships
sub_modules.description: Understand the importance of networking and building relationships for career advancement in design.

activities.name: Finding a Mentor in Your Industry

learning_outcomes: Understand the importance of networking and building relationships for career advancement.
Develop strategies for effective networking and relationship-building.

sub_modules.title: Continuous Learning and Skill Development
sub_modules.description: Learn how to stay up-to-date with industry trends and develop new skills to advance your career as a professional designer.

activities.name: Sharing Knowledge and Best Practices with Peers

learning_outcomes: Understand the importance of continuous learning and skill development for career advancement.
Develop strategies for staying current with industry trends and developing new skills.

modules.title: Career Development Plan
modules.description: Create a comprehensive career development plan based on your goals, strengths, and interests.

sub_modules.title: Setting SMART Goals
sub_modules.description: Learn how to set specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound (SMART) goals for your career development.

activities.name: Sharing Your Career Goals with Peers

learning_outcomes: Understand the importance of setting SMART goals for career development.
Develop skills for effective goal-setting.

sub_modules.title: Action Plan Development
sub_modules.description: Learn how to develop an action plan based on your career development goals and strategies.

activities.name: Sharing Your Action Plan with Peers

learning_outcomes: Understand the importance of developing an action plan for career development.
Develop skills for effective action planning.
